sources.circuitGeometry: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; reviewed frozen snapshots in sources/

limitations: Geographic recreations, not laser scans. Unmapped widths and bank angles are approximate.
Mapzen DEM cannot resolve exact racing kerbs, bridge decks, ruts or engineered rally jumps.
Fafe follows the official coordinate trace; the other rally routes are geographic road recreations, not exact WRC event-year timing lines.
Game timing lines move onto suitable straights. Source, native timed and menu-preview lengths are recorded separately.
Ruuhimäki is a mapped Ruuhimäentie road section, omitting the full competition approach and arena loop.

The 37.7 km Sisteron-Thoard corridor is split at Authon to bound mobile terrain-bake memory. Long imports use existing 5 m road mesh sampling; the 24h combined circuit uses an 80 m bilinearly resampled surrounding terrain grid. Road control points are retained.
Regional saved scenery is reused; optional landmark art requests are in ai/needed-graphics.txt.

Terrain diagnostics retain 2 tolerance flags at one Sepang GP roadside point (~5.047 cm vs 5 cm threshold), and 247 flags on Fontbelle, including 160 at minimum cell size. Meshes are finite and load successfully; these remain terrain-quality limitations, not a claim of surveyed accuracy.
